claims.derived: Google's formula is water per prompt = (total energy - overhead energy) x WUE. Output: 0.87 kWh per million tokens x 1.15 L/kWh = 1.00 L per million output tokens (1.0 mL per 1,000). Input: 0.29 x 1.15 = 0.33 L per million. Check: 375 input and 125 output tokens give 0.375 x 0.33 + 0.125 x 1.00 = 0.25 mL against Google's 0.26 mL, which is circular because the energy factors were derived from the same prompt.

source.title: Alphabet earnings, Q2 2025: CEO's remarks

claims.quote: At I/O in May, we announced that we processed 480 trillion monthly tokens across our surfaces. Since then we have doubled that number, now processing over 980 trillion monthly tokens, a remarkable increase.
claims.derived: 42,415,800 MWh = 4.24158e13 Wh; 980e12 x 12 = 1.176e16 tokens; 4.24158e13 / 1.176e16 = 3.61e-3 Wh per token = 3.6 Wh per 1,000 tokens. At 480e12 x 12 the bound is 7.4; at the May 2026 rate of 3.2e15 x 12 (against 2025 electricity, so not a like-for-like year) it is 1.1.

source.title: LLM Inference Energy: A Longitudinal Analysis

claims.quote: For instance, the 8B model on batch size 64 reduces energy per token by 41% (0.20 J to 0.12 J).
claims.derived: 1 J/token = 1e6 J per million tokens / 3600 J per Wh = 277.78 Wh per million tokens. Converted, per OUTPUT token unless stated, with the boundary in brackets: 0.12 J = 33 Wh (GPU only, 8B, batch 64); 0.10 J = 28 Wh and 0.51 J = 142 Wh (GPU, Qwen3 8B and 32B, English); 3.10 J = 861 Wh (GPU net of idle draw, local 7B code model on Ollama, batch size not stated, incl. prompt processing); Joule standard query 0.31 Wh / 300 output tokens = 3.72 J = 1,033 Wh (full node plus PUE, includes the 500 input tokens); Joule reasoning 3.91 Wh / 5,000 = 2.81 J = 781 Wh; Watershed hyperscaler 870 Wh output, 290 Wh input (IT energy before PUE); Couch 1,950 output, 390 input; claude-carbon Sonnet 1.0 J = 278 Wh; Blackwell agent 58.4 J = 16,218 Wh and saturated serving 0.92 J = 256 Wh (whole system, no facility). Reading: whole-service per-output-token figures cluster at about 0.8 to 2 kWh per million output tokens; GPU-only batched figures are about 6 to 30 times lower; the unbatched dedicated agent rig is about 19 times higher than the whole-service figure (16,218 / 870) and 63 times the same rig when saturated.
